page.overview:
Who is Rika?

Rika is a character appearing in , who is an Elite Four member of the Paldea region, specializing in -types.

Rika is a young slender woman with long green hair in a low ponytail and red eyes. For clothing, she wears a gray button-up shirt, a black necktie, black pants with suspenders, brown shoes and matching black gloves. She wears a ear piercing and earrings and is shown wearing glasses when she is working under Geeta.

Her preference for -types is reflected by her green hair resembling grass, and her brown clothing representing the soil itself. Her distinctly wide eyes further reflects her grounded nature.

Rika has a very laid-back and down-to-earth personality, hence her -type specialty. She frequently uses slang in her speech, using "kiddo" as a nickname for the player. When she is working as an interviewer and an Elite Four member, she is more professional and serious, though some of her laid-back personality still leaks through at times.
